messages.plaintextBody:
Thanks Lorna. Noted — 12-month notice is the main cost driver. We'll work up a full advice note on the package and the covenants and get it to the Board ahead of the 13th. Short version: the client and employee non-solicit covenants look solid; the 12-month non-compete is the weak link and I'd want to trade it down.

Sarah
